name: Aplauz WEUR
oneLiner: WEUR is Aplauz's planned euro e-money token, with safeguarded reserves and par redemption; public circulation remains unverified.
collateral: Planned 1:1 EUR reserve backing safeguarded through Stichting Aplauz Foundation: at least 30% cash deposits with EEA credit institutions and at most 70% highly liquid, low-risk EUR instruments. The issuer names ABN AMRO for reserve banking and safeguarding, Fireblocks for digital-asset custody and transfer, Elliptic for AML analytics and Shufti for identity verification. These are issuer-claimed arrangements and whitepaper commitments, not an observed current portfolio or independent reserve reconciliation.
pegMechanism: Aplauz NL B.V., Dutch company number 77446844, describes a direct issuer claim redeemable at par by any holder after onboarding and compliance checks. Its issuance/redemption terms v1.1 of 24 August 2026 specify no redemption minimum and a 100,000 WEUR minimum per initial issuance request. End-to-end redemption should not exceed five business days in most cases, but additional information requests or extraordinary circumstances can extend it; this is not an unconditional settlement maximum. Redemption-only applicants need an EEA EUR bank account; contracted clients may use eligible non-EEA bank accounts. Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain are planned initial networks; production addresses are unpublished.
launchPhaseDetail: The current whitepaper, amended 24 August 2026, states in Part G that WEUR has not yet launched or entered circulation. The homepage offers account creation, issuance and redemption and claims public on-chain verification, creating a lifecycle ambiguity without independently verified production contracts or circulation. Whitepaper publication and offer-start on 8 July are not confirmed issuance dates. ESMA records whitepaper notification on 25 June 2026, separately from its 26 May last-update field. No confirmed launch date is published.
